name: 氛围拼图帖
description: Turn your own photos into Instagram / Xiaohongshu collage posts and carousels in a vibe you describe, with grouping, frames, text and camera stats. No AI image generation.

display_description.en: Lay out your own photos as Instagram or Xiaohongshu collage posts and carousels in the vibe you describe: smart grouping by content, place and time, frames, text, camera stats and date stamps. Photos are only cropped and resized, never AI-edited.
display_description.zh: 把你的照片按氛围排成 Instagram 或小红书拼图帖、轮播图，自动分组并加边框、文字和相机参数。

default_init_input.zh: 把这个文件夹里的照片做成胶片风的 Instagram 拼图帖
default_init_input.en: Turn the photos in this folder into a film-style Instagram collage post

quick_inputs.zh: 把这个文件夹里的照片做成胶片风的 Instagram 拼图帖
quick_inputs.en: Turn the photos in this folder into a film-style Instagram collage post

quick_inputs.zh: 把这次旅行的照片按地点分组，做成一组多页拼图，每页一个地点
quick_inputs.en: Group my trip photos by place and make a series of collage pages, one page per place

quick_inputs.zh: 用这些照片做一个 3 页的轮播图，加上相机参数
quick_inputs.en: Make a 3-slide carousel from these photos with the camera stats

display_description.en: Reads size, orientation, EXIF camera stats, palette and focus point, suggests groups by time, place and folder, and makes a numbered contact sheet.
display_description.zh: 读取照片尺寸、方向、EXIF 相机参数、主色和焦点，按时间、地点、文件夹建议分组，并生成编号缩略图总览。

display_description.en: Renders the post from a layout spec: collage, frames, text, camera stats, date stamp and decorations. Only crops and resizes your photos.
display_description.zh: 按排版方案渲染帖子：拼图、边框、文字、相机参数、日期戳和装饰；只裁剪缩放原图，不做 AI 改图。
